entities.summary: Chang Qu (b. 291 CE, Sanjiang Subdistrict) was a political leader or statesperson of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Sanjiang Subdistrict. Known in the fields of journalists & chroniclers.
